verdict.rationale: BigCommerce's docs state that the API Reference has a built-in Request Runner for trying the REST Management APIs live, and the developer portal advertises an in-browser API Request Runner. That covers the core of an interactive, runnable API reference. missing for 10: evidence that the runner covers APIs beyond REST Management (e.g. a GraphQL Storefront playground), detail on prefilled runnable examples or code samples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
